{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices during downtrends by 0.5-1.0 on average",
    "Model fails to capture momentum peaks, lagging 1-2 days behind true values",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.5) fails to lift forecasts enough, especially in uptrends",
    "Mean reversion effect stronger when deviating from history by >3 from mean",
    "Sentiment acceleration rule: fast sentiment changes (0 to 1 or 1 to 0) amplify forecast error by 30-50%",
    "Model over-corrects when prices have been volatile, producing flat forecasts",
    "Sentiment alignment rule: forecast deviation correlates with sentiment trend (positive sentiment gap when sentiment is rising, negative when sentiment is falling)"
] }
